tl.settings.title: Target Lens
tl.help.title: Help
tl.help.buffDisplay: Classic shows your target's buffs and debuffs as icons inside the Target HUD. List shows them in their own window with names and timers. Off hides them.
tl.help.buffTitle: Shows a title line at the top of the effects list. Only used when Display is List.
tl.help.buffSize: Makes the rows of the effects list bigger or smaller. Only used when Display is List.
tl.help.byMe: Shows the buffs and debuffs that you put on your target.
tl.help.byOthers: Shows the buffs and debuffs that other players put on your target.
tl.help.monster: Shows the effects a monster gives itself, and effects whose source can't be told.
tl.help.hidden: Shows effects the game normally keeps out of sight, such as ones without an icon.
tl.help.hidePermanent: Hides effects that never run out, so only the ones with a timer are left.
tl.help.threatDisplay: Top aggro shows only the player the monster is most angry at. List shows the top players by aggro, plus your own place.
tl.help.threatTitle: Shows a title line at the top of the aggro window.
tl.help.threatSize: Makes the aggro window bigger or smaller.
tl.help.castSize: Makes the cast bar bigger or smaller.
tl.help.bossTitle: Shows a title line at the top of the boss skill timers.
tl.help.bossSize: Makes the boss skill timers bigger or smaller.
tl.help.nearbyTitle: Shows a title line at the top of the nearby monster list.
tl.help.lockRange: Lists only the monsters close enough to lock on to and stay locked. The distance depends on your class.
tl.help.nearbySize: Makes the nearby monster list bigger or smaller.
tl.sel.help.mode: Only the ticked ones: the HUD shows just the effects you tick here. All except ticked: the HUD shows every effect except the ones you tick. Debuffs and buffs each have their own choice.
tl.sel.consequence.onlyDebuffs: The HUD will show no debuffs until you tick some again.
tl.sel.consequence.onlyBuffs: The HUD will show no buffs until you tick some again.
tl.sel.consequence.exceptDebuffs: Nothing will be hidden. The HUD will show every debuff.
tl.sel.consequence.exceptBuffs: Nothing will be hidden. The HUD will show every buff.
